_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1). Source-book: docs/idiom-research/genre-house-edm.md section B (Detroit + modern peak-time techno, 122-140 BPM, swing 50-53 = machine-straight, 909 four-on-the-floor). Companion phrase pack: phrases/techno/. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Techno
blurb: Detroit / peak-time techno: a relentless 909 four-on-the-floor, machine-straight 16th hats, a rolling synth-sub on the root, and one dark minor stab looped into hypnosis.

flavors.label: Hypno Tunnel
flavors.blurb: One minor chord, eight bars, stabbed on the grid - the loop never goes anywhere and that is the point.

flavors.label: Detroit Stab
flavors.blurb: The two-chord stab pair, i to bVII or bVI, cut short and thrown against the 909.

flavors.label: Melodic Techno
flavors.blurb: A four-chord eight-bar loop held as long pads, maj7 on bVI doing the emotional work.

flavors.label: Dub Techno
flavors.blurb: One chord smeared out long and wet on the offbeat, drifting instead of stabbing.

flavors.label: Detroit Gospel
flavors.blurb: The major I to IVsus outlier - hopeful string stabs played in by hand, not quantised.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Techno harmony is texture, not journey. One minor chord can hold eight bars; when it moves it is a stab pair, i to bVII or i to bVI, never a V-i cadence. Natural minor and dorian only. Melodic techno widens to a four-chord eight-bar loop with maj7 on bVI. Dark, modal, repetitive.
